description: Ceilings read the mapped level, and adult-only country labels are Explicit (kid-hold-11 / grown-up-hold-11, #1124; docs/adr/0028-rating-tiers.md, addendum 2026-11-23 (5)): a delta on kid-hold-10.json, which a kid-hold-11 port must still pass except the superseded rows named below, and on every earlier file as kid-hold-10.json says. Written by hand from the ADR text, not computed with an independent reference. (1) A grown-up or custom channel (policy grownUp or custom, and a leftovers pool) under a ceiling reads each rating as the tier holds read it (the 'ratingMap' level of kid-hold-10.json) instead of the US ladder alone: the ceiling is a ladder name with its ladder rank (0 to 7, the same number as the level), and an item passes when the level of its rating is at most that rank. A movie, or an episode with no series ID, is judged on its own rating; an episode of a known series needs the level of its effective rating (its own, or the series' when its own is null or empty) and, when the series has a rating, the level of the series' rating to pass; an episode whose series is missing fails. A rating with no level (unknown or unrated, including no rating) fails every ceiling, and Approved still fails as in kid-hold-6. With no ceiling everything passes. Policy open is still the rules-format reference and reads the US ladder only (rating.json, the pool vectors). The tier limit of grown-up-hold-9 and the Explicit and kids drops are unchanged. (2) AU R, SG R21, KR 19 and JP 19 and 20 (also 19+ and 20+) are level 7 and Explicit, as AU R18+ is: they are adult-only labels. SUPERSEDED rows of kid-hold-10.json: ratingMap AU-R, JP-19, JP-19+, JP-20, JP-20+, KR-19, KR-19+, SG-R21 and R21 are level 7 (were 6), and explicitRating SG-R21, KR-19 and JP-20 are true (were false). The 'customCeiling' rows use the encoding of grown-up-hold-9.json: 'rating' is the item's own, 'seriesRating' the known series' rating of an episode.
